ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the image, red arrows connect several stages: at the upper right is a cluster of yellow oval eggs on a leaf; below are several black larvae with a spiny appearance; on the left is an orange-and-black pupa-like stage; above is a red-orange adult beetle with black spots, resting on a leaf. Reasoning: The red-orange adult with black spots, yellow eggs, black spiny larvae, and pupa stage together match the complete metamorphosis life cycle of a ladybug/ladybird beetle. Therefore, this image shows the life cycle of a ladybug.
